title: SCE formal toolchain (wire schema v1)
description: The tools the formal judges run (TLC, Verus and Apalache), each with its release, where it is fetched from and the sha256 of what is fetched (docs/adr/0146, D3). Kept in sce-build/src/formal/toolchain.json, compiled into sce-codegen and printed by `sce-codegen formal toolchain`, so a consumer's cache key or installer reads the pins of the revision it builds. Authoritative reader is sce-build/src/formal/toolchain.rs. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone; see SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md.

toolchain.description: The Rust release Verus was built with and runs on.

apalache.description: Apalache, the symbolic checker of level 3 (docs/adr/0115, D3): the release's .tgz, which holds its launcher, its jar and the standard module Apalache that TLC is given for a model extending it.
